VITA 站点多数 2 月到 5 月开，有的全年开。: Most VITA sites open February through May; some are open year-round.
IRS 写明：VITA 没有全项目统一的收入上限，各站点可以自己定；常见服务对象: The IRS says VITA has no program-wide income limit and each site may set its own; it commonly serves people who make about $70,244 or less, people with disabilities and limited-English taxpayers. TCE focuses on pensions and retirement-related tax questions for people 60 and older. Both are free, with IRS-certified volunteers preparing your return.
第一步：找到离你最近的免费报税点: Step 1: find the nearest free tax site
在 IRS 的 VITA／TCE 查询工具输入邮编，或拨打 800-906-98: Enter your ZIP code in the IRS VITA / TCE locator or call 800-906-9887. Most TCE sites are run by the AARP Foundation's Tax-Aide program: from January to April use the AARP site locator or call 888-227-7669. What each site can prepare depends on that season's volunteers, so name your income types when you book.
用 IRS 官方查询找报税点: Find a site with the IRS locator
输入邮编查站点；也可拨打 800-906-9887。: Search by ZIP code, or call 800-906-9887.
预约时说清：税务年份、收入类型（工资、退休金、自雇等）、要报联邦还是加州，以及需: When you book, say the tax year, your income types (wages, pension, self-employment …), whether you need federal, California or both, and your language.
出门前按 IRS 的 what to bring 清单带齐身份证明、各类税表和上: Before you go, follow the IRS "what to bring" list: ID, all tax forms and a copy of last year's return.
AARP Tax-Aide 的站点查询每年 1 月到 4 月开放；秋天先记下电话: The AARP Tax-Aide site locator runs January to April; in the fall, save the number and book once tax season opens.
第二步：自己报加州税，用免费的 CalFile: Step 2: filing California yourself? Use free CalFile
FTB 写明 CalFile 完全免费，可直接向加州税务局在线申报州税，目前接受: FTB says CalFile is completely free: you e-file your state return directly with the Franchise Tax Board, and it now accepts tax years 2023, 2024 and 2025. Your federal return is filed separately with the IRS; a "free federal" ad does not cover the California return, so check each one.

第三步：2027 年报税季，几个日期分开看: Step 3: the 2027 filing season, one date at a time
IRS（联邦）：2027 年哪天开始接收个人税表，IRS 还没公布。上一季的开放: IRS (federal): the IRS has not announced when it will start accepting 2027 individual returns. Last season opened on January 26, 2026, and the IRS announced that date only on January 8, 2026. Testing dates for tax software companies are not the opening day for individual returns.
FTB（加州电子报税）：FTB 的电子报税日历还列着 2026 年 1 月 2: FTB (California e-file): FTB's e-file calendar still lists January 2, 2026 as the first day to transmit current-year returns; 2027 dates are not listed yet.
CalFile：目前接受 2023、2024 和 2025 税务年度；2026: CalFile: it now accepts tax years 2023, 2024 and 2025; FTB has not announced when tax year 2026 (filed in 2027) will open.
VITA 本地站点：FTB 写明多数站点 2 月到 5 月开，有的全年开；开门和: Local VITA sites: FTB says most sites open February through May and some are open year-round; each site announces its own opening and appointment dates, and there is no single Bay Area opening day. Even at a year-round site, tax year 2026 returns can be filed only once the IRS and FTB start accepting them.
AARP Tax-Aide 和 IRS 查询工具：IRS 写明 1 月到 4 月: AARP Tax-Aide and the IRS locator: the IRS says the AARP site locator works January through April, and the IRS's own locator is updated regularly February through April.
